description: Énergies renouvelables raccordées sur le réseau SRD - par maille IRIS is a dataset listed in SRD OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SRD. Énergies renouvelables raccordées au réseau SRD: Nombre d'installations / Puissance de raccordement / Énergie produite Agrégat des filières de production: ÉOLIEN / SOLAIRE / BIOGAZ / MÉTHANISATION / HYDRAULIQUE Attention: ce jeu de données est publié mensuellement (données actualisées au dernier jour du mois M-1) Ce jeu de données présente donc la vision du nombre ... Coverage: Vienne (SRD electricity network). The portal files it under Production et stockage. Its keywords are Point d'injection, Puissance de raccordement, Énergie injectée, IRIS. The portal shows 285 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte version 2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-srd-energies-fr-portal.
